instruction: Angelica asked me for my song recommendations over email. I started drafting the response email off the top of my head. But then realized I can mine it from my Spotify account! Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.

# Fetch album library song ids and playlist song ids, plus re-check song library
spotify_token = apis.spotify.login(username='eric.bailey@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

# liked songs
liked=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('liked page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    liked.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
liked_dict={s['song_id']: s for s in liked}
print('liked total', len(liked_dict))

# song library
song_lib=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('song library page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    song_lib.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
song_lib_ids=set([s['song_id'] for s in song_lib])
print('song library total', len(song_lib_ids))

# album library
album_song_ids=set()
albums=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('album library page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    albums.extend(page)
    for a in page:
        album_song_ids.update(a.get('song_ids', []))
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print('album library albums', len(albums), 'album_song_ids', len(album_song_ids))

# playlist library
playlist_song_ids=set()
playlists=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='', is_public=None, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlist library page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    for pl in page:
        playlist_song_ids.update(pl.get('song_ids', []))
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print('playlists', len(playlists), 'playlist_song_ids', len(playlist_song_ids))

# union filter
included_ids = [sid for sid in liked_dict.keys() if sid in song_lib_ids or sid in album_song_ids or sid in playlist_song_ids]
print('included liked songs', len(included_ids))
print('included song ids', sorted(included_ids)[:20])
# For each included song, show which sets it matches
for sid in sorted(included_ids)[:10]:
    flags=[]
    if sid in song_lib_ids: flags.append('song_lib')
    if sid in album_song_ids: flags.append('album_lib')
    if sid in playlist_song_ids: flags.append('playlist')
    s=liked_dict[sid]
    print(s['title'], '->', ','.join(flags), 'artists:', [a['name'] for a in s.get('artists',[])], 'album:', s.get('album_title'))
